pixelCoverage.rule: Exclude every pixel whose centre lies inside a marked element from both the ink numerator and the included-pixel denominator.

decoratedElementBudget.rule: Exclude only a visible direct text node beneath the required-accuracy marker from the budgeted text contribution. Never exclude its pixels, descendants for another reason, border, filled background, or background image. Raw decorated counts are never reduced.

interactiveBudget.rule: The exclusions apply only to interactiveElementCount; rawInteractiveElementCount and focusableElementCount remain diagnostic and unmodified.

methodology.ink: Convert screenshot sRGB to CIELAB with the D65/2 degree reference white and count an included pixel as ink when CIEDE2000 deltaE00 against #f7f8f1 is at least 8.
methodology.whiteSpace: 1 - inkCoverageRatio on exactly the same included-pixel denominator.
methodology.exactGroundRatio: Diagnostic only: exact sRGB equality with #f7f8f1 among included pixels.
methodology.screenshotHash: SHA-256 of the exact encoded PNG bytes.
methodology.pixelExclusions: At DPR 1, exclude a pixel when its centre is inside a rectangle emitted by the canonical pixel-exclusion selector; overlapping rectangles exclude a pixel once.
methodology.interactive: First-viewport interactive elements, with the interactive-only exclusions declared above.
methodology.visibleText: Normalized direct text-node characters whose rendered range intersects the first viewport; navigation remains included.
methodology.decoratedElements: Raw counts include every first-viewport element carrying visible direct text, a nonzero border, a filled background, or a background image. Budgeted counts apply only the required-accuracy direct-text exclusion declared above; visual decoration still counts.
methodology.primaryContentPadding: Use the content edge (left border edge plus computed padding-left) of the canonical primary-content marker when present. Otherwise use the minimum left edge of visible direct-text ranges and visible controls/media inside main or role=main, falling back to body, while excluding navigation, footer, Copilot, and aria-hidden content.
methodology.proseMeasure: For every rendered p and li, divide its rendered width by the measured advance of ten zero glyphs using that element’s computed font properties.
methodology.adjacentSections: Use canonical top-level-section markers when present; otherwise use unnested semantic section elements inside primary content. The gap is next.top minus previous.bottom in DOM order.
methodology.primaryClaim: Within the canonical primary-claim marker, count visible elements carrying direct text and visible figure, svg, canvas, data-figure-kind, or role=img descendants.
methodology.horizontalOverflow: documentElement.scrollWidth minus viewport width; at 390px the maximum is zero.
methodology.canonicalManifestHash: Sort matching files by repository-relative POSIX path. For each raw file, append `<sha256>  <path>\n` with two ASCII spaces. SHA-256 the concatenated UTF-8 lines; absolute paths and enumeration order are excluded.
